failureStage: after ordinal-0 Unity process creation, before trusted process identity acceptance and before any completed measured process
errorMessage: Exception calling "GetFullPath" with "1" argument(s): "The path is empty. (Parameter 'path')"
rootCause: Get-ProcessIdentity queried Win32_Process immediately after Start-Process and unconditionally passed the returned ExecutablePath to System.IO.Path.GetFullPath. For ordinal 0, Win32_Process returned an empty ExecutablePath; GetFullPath therefore threw before executable and command-line identity could be accepted. The evidence does not establish whether the empty property was caused by query timing, process lifecycle, or provider access behavior.
minimumProspectiveRepair: In a new supervisor version, make process-identity acquisition fail-safe by bounded polling for a non-empty ExecutablePath and CommandLine tied to the launched PID, with an explicit timeout/failure receipt and no acceptance until executable, runner method, measured root, PID and creation time all match. Repeat implementation freeze, static validation, compile/readiness and final freeze before requesting a wholly new collection attempt.
